svg.title: Pipeline diagram with adaptive keypoint extractor, correspondence aligner, structural localization, and refinement stage
svg.desc: Editable reconstruction of the supplied four-panel method figure. Base frames f01 to f04 correspond to panels (a) through (d); f05 and f06 are inner highlighted algorithm regions. No external crops or SAM assets are used.

g.desc: Origin at point-cloud inset for P t minus 1; Voxel Net is to the right and a voxel lattice feature F t minus 1 is farther right.

Panel a content inventory: coordinate origin cuboid B t minus 1 at left, four Q0 keypoint feature circles, small n_x n_y n_z sampling cube, arrows through self attention, cross attention, FFN, and output feature column F kpt t minus 1; dashed red correspondences go upward to R tr t minus 1 point cloud.
Origin at P t point cloud; the voxel grid provides frame features to the progressive correspondence aligner.

Panel b content inventory: left input query feature column Q t zero, shared horizontal main arrow, Stage 1 and Stage S residual correspondence modules with plus nodes, internal dotted sequence Q t one to Q t S minus 1, outputs R t S and F kpt t S. It has approximate horizontal symmetry around the main correspondence line.

Panel c content inventory: structural graph deltas ΔF t minus 1 and ΔF t at left feed a confidence predictor; a color/scale legend multiplies two keypoint feature stacks, then MLP extractor and head output pose vector. Symmetry basis is left-to-right dataflow with stacked parallel color rows.

Panel d content inventory: one refinement stage structure inside a dashed frame, carrying Q t S minus 1 and R t S minus 1 inputs through plus node, MLP_PE, self attention, cross attention with F t, deformable attention with F t and R t S minus 1, MLP offset, and output Q t S plus R t S. The section is a left-to-right chain with a lower residual path.
